page_note: 这是瑞再研究院报告第4页，左右两栏正文之间嵌有三幅浅蓝底图：Figure 6（上半年雷暴损失柱状+趋势线）、Figure 7（上下半年占比堆叠面积）和 Figure 8（按季度与灾种的平均损失堆叠柱，并在柱上标注份额百分比）。

heading.title: Global insured losses from SCS in 1H (USD bn, 2025 prices)
Global insured losses from SCS in 1H and 2H, %
Average global insured losses (USD billion), and share of losses (%), from natural catastrophes by quarter and peril (1995–2024; 2025 prices)

dark teal bars plus a light green rising "Trend" line in the same panel
"First half SCS" square and "Trend" line swatch in a row under the x axis
horizontal rules at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 only; no vertical rules
about 31 yearly bars but ticks only 1997, 2001, 2005 ... 2025
axis shows bare 0, 10 ... 50; scale only in title "(USD bn, 2025 prices)"
dark "First half" band with light "Second half" band stacked over the year axis
bands fill to the 100 tick every year on an axis reading 0 to 100, title ends ", %"
"First half" and "Second half" swatches in a row under the 1996–2024 axis
yearly jagged vertices but ticks only at 1996, 2000, 2004 ... 2024
title "Global insured losses from SCS in 1H and 2H, %"; axis ticks are bare numbers

four swatches "Convective storms  Cyclones  Earthquakes  Floods" under the 1Q–4Q axis

new_components.name: label_unit_differs_from_axis
new_components.evidence: axis is USD billion 0–35 but printed labels 18%, 22%, 44%, 16% are shares of annual losses
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一图上柱高与标签是两种量纲，读数时必须先判定 44% 不是 USD bn，而 30 左右的柱高才是金额，否则会把百分比当成数值填入表格。

new_components.name: trend_series_without_own_axis_or_points
new_components.evidence: "Trend" is a smooth fitted curve with no markers, legend swatch is a line, same axis as bars
new_components.why_it_matters: 趋势线没有可对齐的年度点位，取其 2025 年末端值（约35）只能靠曲线与网格线交点估读，行标签也只能借用柱子的年份刻度。

new_components.name: caption_number_inline_with_title
new_components.evidence: "Figure 6:" in bold blue runs inline with the lighter-blue title on the same tinted line
new_components.why_it_matters: 图号与标题同一行且同色系，解析出的markdown可能把二者合并成一段普通文字，导致表格上方缺少可识别的粗体标题。

difficulty_notes: 十个待测值中有八个没有印在图上。Figure 6 的价值轴只有 0,10,20,30,40,50 六个刻度，10 个单位约 50 px，要把顶峰柱读成 45（±2.25，即约 11 px）几乎落在描线粗细的量级内，实际柱高约 43–44，已接近 5% 边界；33 与 32 两根柱在同图上仅差 5 px，一次误判就同时报废两条记录。Figure 7 是 0,20,40,60,80,100 的百分比面积图，20 个单位约 50 px，读 70%/80%（±3.5 与 ±4）需要在无网格的绿色/深青分界上估位，而且 29 个年度顶点只配 8 个四年间隔刻度，还要先确定是哪一年。相比之下标签问题（步骤3）虽然存在——Figure 6 顶峰柱对应的 2023 年份在页面上根本没印——但数值本身能否落进 5% 已是更前置的阻塞。

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 label_unit_differs_from_axis（柱上百分比标签 + USD bn 价值轴）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中新增 value_label_unit，与 value_axis_unit 独立取值；记录字段区分 mark 数值与其标注文本
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 「标签量纲=轴量纲」对照「标签量纲≠轴量纲」时的数值抽取正确率

suggestions.what_to_add: pct_stacked 的面积形态（归一化堆叠面积到 100）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图族权重向量中把 stacked_area 拆为 absolute 与 normalized 两档
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 归一化堆叠面积图在生成分布中占比 0% 与占比 10% 两种训练配置的对比行

suggestions.what_to_add: 三行折行标题、图号内联、单位嵌在括号中（Figure 8 的 heading 拆分）

suggestions.what_to_add: sparse_time_ticks（31 根年度柱只有每四年一个刻度）
suggestions.where_to_change: 刻度格式样式维度增加 tick_every_n 参数，并要求记录保留未印出的类别名
